result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is tokio as the async runtime, because it has a better ecosystem.

The records hold two decisions on this. #19 chose async-std, and the later #21 ("Actually tokio has a better ecosystem") chose tokio. #21 has no formal "replaces #19" link, so I went by the order and wording: it is the newer one and says "Actually". The file doesn't mention async-std. If you meant both to stand, tell me and I'll change it.

The first attempt to write the file with a shell heredoc failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.

The Muninn heartbeat also reported 11 hook runs that started and never finished. I didn't look into that.
